# Calendar

`from xurrent import Calendar` · module `xurrent.calendars` · API resource `/calendars` · [Xurrent API docs](https://developer.xurrent.com/v1/calendars/)

Business hours (calendar hours per weekday) and holidays that define when service hours, support
hours and SLA clocks run.

### get_duration

```python
calendar.get_duration(start: str, end: str, time_zone: str = None) -> dict
```

Calculate the duration between two timestamps according to the calendar.

- `start`: Start datetime string (ISO 8601)
- `end`: End datetime string (ISO 8601)
- `time_zone`: Optional time zone name
- Returns: Duration data from the API

API: `GET /calendars/{id}/duration`
